pk.context: 10 mg oral, single dose, healthy adults

tell: A prodrug activated inside lymphocytes by phosphorylation, this purine antimetabolite carries a boxed malignancy warning.

clues.text: Bioavailability is about 40%; a high-fat meal cuts Cmax by 29% and leaves AUC unchanged. Protein binding is 20%, and 28.5% of the dose is excreted unchanged by active renal secretion.
A white or almost white crystalline powder with a molecular weight of 285.69. It is stable at neutral and slightly basic pH.
An NDA product supplied as 10 mg tablets, dispensed as one box for each treatment cycle.

Boxed warning for malignancy and teratogenicity. Contraindicated with current malignancy, in pregnant women and in HIV infection; upper respiratory tract infection and headache are the most common reactions.
Relapsing forms of multiple sclerosis in adults, including relapsing-remitting disease and active secondary progressive disease.
Its mechanism is not fully known, but it is thought to be cytotoxic to B and T lymphocytes by impairing DNA synthesis.
The generic name begins with C and has ten letters.
